title: Range Add, First Index at Least X, and Range Max

notes.title: Original PDF
notes.html:
The problem as given on DomJudge:

prob-Lazy.pdf

statement_html:
You are given an array A[1..N] of N integers. Process Q operations of three types:

  1. Range increment 1 l r v: add v to every A[i] with l <= i <= r.

  2. First threshold position 2 l r x: print the smallest index j with l <= j <= r and A[j] >= x, or -1 if there is none.

  3. Range maximum 3 l r: print max(A[l..r]).

Input: the first line has N and Q; the second line has A[1..N]; each of the next Q lines is one operation.

Output: one line for each operation of type 2 or 3.

Example 1:

Input:
7 8
2 1 5 3 4 1 6
2 2 7 5
1 2 5 3
2 2 7 7
3 1 5
1 1 7 -4
2 1 7 5
1 6 7 5
2 4 7 4
Output:
3
3
8
-1
7
Explanation:
2 2 7 5   -> first A[j] >= 5 in [2,7] is A[3] = 5            -> 3
1 2 5 3   -> A = [2,4,8,6,7,1,6]
2 2 7 7   -> A[3] = 8                                       -> 3
3 1 5     -> max(2,4,8,6,7)                                 -> 8
1 1 7 -4  -> A = [-2,0,4,2,3,-3,2]
2 1 7 5   -> nothing reaches 5                              -> -1
1 6 7 5   -> A = [-2,0,4,2,3,2,7]
2 4 7 4   -> A[7] = 7                                       -> 7

Constraints:

  • 1 <= N, Q <= 2 × 105

  • -109 <= A[i], v, x <= 109 (values can grow beyond 32 bits)

  • 1 <= l <= r <= N

Hint: a segment tree with lazy propagation storing the maximum of each node; for type 2, descend into the leftmost child whose maximum is at least x.
